_comment: SLO thresholds for pass/fail verdicts. UNCALIBRATED TEMPLATE.
parse_results.py will refuse to use this file until "calibrated" is
true, and will refuse it then unless "source" records where the numbers
came from. Until both are set the suite reports figures and no verdict,
which is the correct behaviour: a PASS against an invented threshold is
worse than no verdict, because it looks like it means something.
To calibrate, measure the target environment and record:
- block size distribution and read/write ratio of the real NiFi flow
- sustained and peak rate the environment actually needs
- the latency at which the application degrades, not a round number
Every threshold is optional; omit what you have not measured rather
than filling it with a guess.
